title: Felt You Leaving
description: A fragile felt piano and a low pad open beatless and tender, then a soft 707 kit and sub creep in for a slow-burn bloom before everything recedes back into reverb and delay. Dreamy and emotional, it builds patiently and lets go just as gently.
code:
setcpm(120/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").s("piano").room(0.5).gain(0.6)
      .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.32)),
    note("<c2 ab1>/2").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(320, 700)).room(0.55).gain(0.45)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f3,ab3,c4,eb4] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").room(0.45).gain(0.6)
      .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3)),
    note("<c2 ab1>/2").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(24).range(360, 1100)).room(0.5).gain(0.45),
    s("hh(5,8)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.3).crush(8).room(0.3).cut(1)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f3,ab3,c4,eb4] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").room(0.4).gain(0.58)
      .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.28)),
    note("<c2 c2 ab1 g1>").s("sine").lpf(420).shape(0.25).room(0.2).gain(0.6),
    s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.62),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR707").room(0.35).gain(0.4),
    s("hh(5,8)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.34).crush(8).cut(1).swingBy(0.08, 8)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<[f3,ab3,c4,eb4] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").room(0.6).delay("0.4:0.166:0.5").gain(0.6)
      .off(0.25, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3)),
    note("<c2 ab1>/2").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(400, 1600)).room(0.6).gain(0.42)
  )],
  [28, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f3,ab3,c4,eb4] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").room(0.4).gain(0.58)
      .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3))
      .every(8, x => x.rev()),
    note("<c2 c2 ab1 g1>").s("sine").lpf(520).shape(0.3).room(0.2).gain(0.62),
    s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.64),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR707").room(0.35).gain(0.42),
    s("hh*3").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.32).crush(7).cut(1).degradeBy(0.2),
    s("hh(7,8)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.3).cut(1).swingBy(0.08, 8)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").s("piano").room(0.6).delay("0.4:0.166:0.5").gain(0.58)
      .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.28)),
    note("<c2 ab1>/2").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(520, 320)).room(0.6).gain(0.4)
  )]
)
